caption: Castello di Dolceacqua, Dolceacqua
composition: Ruined castle above Dolceacqua village and river bridge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The ruined castle crowns the crag at the top of the frame, its broken towers and walls silhouetted against a clear blue sky, with the pastel houses of Dolceacqua tumbling down the slope beneath it. The old stone bridge with its two arches crosses the river at the lower left, and wooded hills close the right. At 09:31 the light is bright morning sun, and the village glows warm against the dark green slopes.
